entities.summary: North Korea is a sovereign nation in East Asia, Asia. Its capital is Pyongyang. Official languages include Korean. Government: Unitary one-party totalitarian Juche socialist republic. Population: approximately 26.2 million. Area: 120,538 km². Comprehensive index for North Korea (DPRK) covering ancient Gojoseon, Three Kingdoms (Goguryeo), Unified Silla, Goryeo, Joseon Dynasty, Japanese colonization 1910-1945, post-WWII Soviet occupation zone, Kim Il Sung's Korean War (1950-53, ceasefire only), Juche ideology, totalitarian state, famine 1990s, nuclear weapons program (2006+ tests), hereditary dictatorship (Kim dynasty), cult of personality, and extreme isolation.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: North Korea's nuclear weapons program has had significant regional and thematic impact, with multiple tests since 2006 and a continued threat to global security. Its hereditary dictatorship and cult of personality have also led to widespread human rights abuses and economic isolation.
